_meta.host: VM local (NOT docker). HARDWARE (5090 re-installed, verified this phase): NVML/PCI idx 0=RTX3080(20480MiB,05:00.0), 1=RTX5090(32607MiB,0A:00.0), 2=RTX3080(20480MiB,0B:00.0). _meta.harness: bench_measure.py --api sglang (/generate meta_info; ignore_eos + warmup-prefill + warmup-decode); bench_run.sh via htsglang_local_run.sh; KV_PARSE=sglang (max_total_num_tokens boot line).

metric_defs.prefill20k: P1: single request, 20000 exact unique input_ids, max_new_tokens=1, tok/s (after discarded warmup prefill)
metric_defs.par8_prefill: P8: 8 parallel x 6000 exact input_ids, total prompt / batch wall (aggregate tok/s)
metric_defs.par8_decode_code: D8 CODE: 8 parallel x ~400-tok decode (ignore_eos), aggregate tok/s
metric_defs.maxKV_tokens: sglang boot line max_total_num_tokens at the cell's config

variants.V1: max-KV: --rank-tp-ratio auto (VRAM-weighted uneven split) + SGLANG_UNEVEN_DCP=1 + _WEIGHTED=1 + calibrated SGLANG_UNEVEN_TOKEN_VECTOR + SGLANG_MAMBA_SSM_DTYPE=bfloat16 + calibrated --rank-auto-reserve-mib. No vocab-ratio (plain max-KV).
variants.V2: max-perf @ >=100k KV: --rank-tp-ratio auto-performance --rank-perf-tune both --rank-perf-loose-ctx-percent 0 + --rank-vocab-ratio auto (13,6,6) + DCP/WEIGHTED + bf16 mamba. Single boot applies the full perf stack AND emits the floor-check/PIN-HINT/VOCAB-HINT evidence.

global_caveats: fp8 KV everywhere (--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3). MTP/NEXTN spec ACTIVE every decode (--speculative-algorithm NEXTN --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4).

CUDA graphs ON: decode + target-verify + draft graphs captured. GGUF Q6 is multimodal (mmproj vision tower auto-loaded) => sglang auto-disables the prefill CUDA graph ('Breakable CUDA graph is incompatible with multimodal model'); FP8/AWQ prefill graph also 'disabled' backend per boot config (chunked-prefill path). Decode graphs always on.
Concurrency NOT mamba-capped here (unlike the 2x3080 TP=2 cells): auto-mamba sized 100 slots (~admits ~20 reqs) with the 5090 in the mix, so par8 = REAL 8-way batching (D8 >> D1).
UNCACHED verified: unique-nonce token-id prompts; max_cached_tokens=0 every cell.

V2 auto-performance is INFEASIBLE on GGUF at this HEAD: uneven_perf.py:531 PerfCostModel._load_config does open(model_path/'config.json'); for GGUF model_path is the .gguf FILE => NotADirectoryError. So GGUF V2 uses a PINNED-MLP approximation (--rank-tp-ratio auto + explicit --rank-mlp-ratio + --rank-vocab-ratio auto, which IS GGUF-safe: cached-hw-profile only). FP8/AWQ V2 use the real auto-performance optimizer.

Q6/Q8 GGUF multimodal warmup OOM: sglang's built-in server warmup sends an IMAGE request; at the DCP-maximized KV pool (0.22 GB free) the vision path OOMs even though text serving is fine. Fix (text-only benchmark): --skip-server-warmup + reserve bumped to leave ~1.6 GB headroom. bench_measure sends only text/input_ids (no images), so the vision path is never exercised in measurement.

Reserve calibration: FP8 V1 & all reserve-bumped GGUF cells use --rank-auto-reserve-mib 3000,2200,2200 (avoids the graph-capture / GGUF-dequant OOM that generic R=1500 hits; F2 lesson). AWQ V1 fits at R=1500.

_audit_M28_2026-07-17.scope: maxKV-only audit vs vLLM cross-check; speed metrics untouched; GPUs verified 0 MiB
_audit_M28_2026-07-17.finding: TP3 V1 max_total_num_tokens is ~half of the vLLM (shvllm) 'GPU KV cache size' numbers, but this is a config+accounting difference, NOT a broken/uncalibrated KV number.

token_vector_forensics.awq_tp3_V1: UNCALIBRATED: pinned the historical no-MTP vector 31,15,18; boot emitted hint 32,13,19 -> ~654144 (reported 566912).
token_vector_forensics.fp8_tp3_V1: CALIBRATED: boot logged 'converged (balanced)' [33,13,18], no divergent hint.

root_cause_of_2x_gap_vs_vllm: auto-mamba pool sized by --max-running-requests 16 -> 100 mamba slots (ratio5*conc16*safety1.25); ~5.36GB on the 5090, carved BEFORE the token-KV pool. vLLM used --max-num-seqs 8.
reserve 3000/2200/2200 MiB (GGUF dequant/graph headroom) vs vLLM 1500 uniform.

vLLM 'GPU KV cache size' comes from the unified hybrid KV manager (mamba page padded to attn page, shared num_blocks) so it counts mamba blocks as token-equivalents; sglang max_total_num_tokens reports only the separate full-attn token pool -> the two numbers are not directly comparable.
